name: Sikkim

flag.description: A white field with a broad red border, bearing a golden khorlo, the Buddhist Wheel of Dharma, in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The khorlo, or Wheel of Dharma, represents Buddhism, the religion of Sikkim's Chogyal kings.

hook: Sikkim's flag is a golden Buddhist wheel on white inside a thick red frame.
trivia: After a referendum in 1975 the monarchy was abolished and Sikkim became India's 22nd state.
Sikkim's kings bore the title Chogyal, "righteous ruler"; the last, Palden Thondup Namgyal, married the American Hope Cooke in 1963.
